title: Edge-inducibility at most k over k minus r ell times one over e for hypergraphs with maximum nonempty edge size r at least three and one at most ell less than k over r
author: Jacob Fox and Lisa Sauermann
work: A completion of the proof of the edge-statistics conjecture

difficulty_reason: The proof controls an exact induced edge count without any regularity or independence of the hypergraph edges. It defines a normalized distribution on extendable ordered vertex sequences, classifies last-vertex link families, and bounds all prefix-extension denominators through forbidden completions. Averaging over label permutations produces an exponential gain whose optimization gives the universal one-over-e factor. The complete original new core is explicit; supporting elementary estimates and helper statements are not separate units.
